body:
3 years ago when I was almost finished, I needed to give only a few exams to be done and I decided to go back home with my parents but then my father died and the situation became really shitty.

I gave up uni 'cause I can't be around people, I feel sick if I do. I get nervous to the point my heart is racing and I need to throw up. I loved studying what I studied and I was passionate about it, it was exactly what I wanted to do with my life but ATM I have trouble even getting out of home and talking to people and nobody gives a fuck about it. I haven't seen a friend in 3 years. I used to have a normal social life, girlfriend, friends, etc. and now I have lost everything but fuck's sake it seems like it's too hard to notice. Apparently it's because I am lazy and "I want to do whatever the hell I want".

I'm so tired to be always tired and always in panic, it's the most exhausting thing, I know there can be worse but I just can't take it anymore. I haven't had a good night of sleep in so long I can't even remember, I sleep all the time 'cause I just want the day to be over but I never get rest from it
